title: Web Search Tool — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Searches the internet for relevant information, ranked and cited. The Web Search Tool queries public web search over accessible sources and returns ranked results with titles, snippets, and URLs. It deduplicates results, filters to the requested recency or domain when asked, and hands result pages to the web page reader for full content extraction. Every result carries its source URL for citation.
capabilities: Result ranking with titles, snippets, URLs
